name: EURA
collateral: Diversified euro-denominated collateral basket inside the Angle Transmuter, historically composed of EURC, EURe, and tokenized euro debt; during the wind-down EURA is redeemable 1:1 for EURC through the Transmuter until 2027-03-01
pegMechanism: Wind-down redemption: EURA holders can redeem 1:1 for EURC on Ethereum through the Angle Transmuter (legacy Borrowing module deprecated); after the 2027-03-01 cutoff the guardian multisig recovers remaining reserves and airdrops them pro-rata via Merkl

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Dilutable retained: governance-controlled mint authority through Angle Treasury and Transmuter contracts without a confirmed holder-balance freeze or arbitrary-burn surface on the EURA token itself.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Pharos lane D Wave 3 non-USD review

notices.title: Protocol in wind-down
notices.message: Angle Protocol is sunsetting EURA and USDA following governance vote AIP-112. EURA is redeemable 1:1 for EURC via the Transmuter on Ethereum until 2027-03-01. After that date, residual reserves will be airdropped pro-rata to remaining holders via Merkl, and the peg may break.
